name: Trit Decode Parity Bridge
head: 6ea235e40
summary: Fixed decoder spanning trit bit ordering from (HIGH<<low_count|LOW) to canonical (LOW<<high_count|HIGH). Fixed MAGIC constant from 0x54524954 to 0x54495254. Fixed harness fixture writer header field offsets (block_rows at offset 16, block_cols at offset 18). All 4 harness tests now pass.
canonical_spanning_order: bits = (LOW << high_count) | HIGH where high_count = 8 - bit_off, low_count = 3 - high_count. HIGH bits from first byte at bit_off, LOW bits from second byte at bit 0.
limitations: Harness fixture writer must use same header layout as decoder. No block-level scales in fixture (n_scales=1). Python reference implementation not yet cross-validated.
next_phase: Phase 28AZ - Python reference trit encoder/decoder for cross-language parity verification
